topics.body: The executable grammar and compiler-owned token tables define the public source spellings.

examples.name: source surface
examples.source:
# This case exercises the implemented surface syntax for modules and expressions.
fn choose(value: Option<Int>) -> Int
	match value
		Some(count) => count
		None => 0
	end
end

fn summarize(input: { count : Int, label : String, }) -> { count : Int, label : String, }
	let { count: count, label: label } = input
	let _: Int = count + 1
	{ count: count, label: label }
end

fn inferred_value()
	1
end

fn qualified_option(value: Option<Int>) -> Int
	match value
		Option::Some(count) => count
		Option::None => 0
	end
end

fn render(value: Int) -> String
	int_to_string(value)
end

fn nested_match(input: Bool) -> { label : String, values : Vec<Int>, chosen : Int }
	{ label: render(match input
		true => 1
		false => 0
	end), values: [match input
		true => 2
		false => 3
	end], chosen: match input
		true => 4
		false => 5
	end }
end

fn dictionary(seed: Int) -> Dict<Int, String>
	{ seed + 1: "next", 0: "zero" }
end

fn classify(result: Result<{ count : Int, label : String }, String>) -> String
	match result
		Result::Ok({ count: count, label: label }) => label
		Result::Err(error) => error
	end
end

pub fn main() -> Int
	let value: Int = Some(2) |> choose()
	let summary = summarize({ count: value, label: "ok" })
	let qualified: Int = qualified_option(Option::Some(inferred_value()))
	let _: Dict<Int, String> = dictionary(summary.count)
	let grouped: Int = summary.count + qualified
	let label: String = classify(Result::Ok({ count: grouped, label: "ok" }))
	let failure: String = classify(Result::Err("err"))
	let placed = nested_match(label == "ok")
	let _: String = placed.label
	let _: Int = placed.chosen + vec_len(placed.values)
	let _: Bool = label == "ok" and failure != ""
	grouped
end

grammar:
Module        ::= UseDecl* Item*
UseDecl       ::= "use" ModulePath ImportSource? NL
ImportSource  ::= "from" PackageString
ModulePath    ::= Name ("::" Name)*
PackageString ::= String
IntLiteral    ::= DecimalLiteral | BinaryLiteral | HexadecimalLiteral
DecimalLiteral ::= ASCII decimal digit+
BinaryLiteral ::= "0b" ("0" | "1")+
HexadecimalLiteral ::= "0x" ASCII hexadecimal digit+
Item          ::= Function | TestDecl | EffectDecl | HandlerDecl | TypeDecl | SchemaDecl | PublicAlias
Function      ::= "pub"? "fn" Name EffectBinder? "(" ParamList? ")" Return? Effects? NL
                  Contract* Body "end" NL?
TestDecl      ::= "test" Name "(" ")" Return Effects? NL
                  Contract* Body "end" NL?
TypeDecl      ::= "pub"? "type" Name TypeParamList? NL TypeVariant+ "end" NL?
EffectDecl    ::= "pub"? "effect" Name NL EffectOperation+ "end" NL?
EffectOperation ::= Name "(" EffectParamList? ")" "->" TypeText NL
EffectParamList ::= Name ":" TypeText ("," Name ":" TypeText)*
HandlerDecl   ::= "pub"? "handler" Name "(" ParamList? ")" "handles" MemberPath Effects? NL HandlerOperationClause+ "end" NL?
HandlerOperationClause ::= Name "(" HandlerOperationParams? ")" "=>" Expr NL
HandlerOperationParams ::= Name ("," Name)*
SchemaDecl    ::= "pub"? "schema" Name NL SchemaFormat? SchemaField+ SchemaValidation? "end" NL?
SchemaFormat  ::= "format" "binary" NL
SchemaField   ::= Name ":" SchemaFieldType SchemaFieldWhere? NL
SchemaFieldType ::= TypeText | LowercaseSchemaPrimitive | LowercaseReservedBitsPrimitive | ReservedBitsPrimitive | RepeatPrimitive | CanonicalRepeatPrimitive
LowercaseSchemaPrimitive ::= "uint" IntLiteral ("be" | "le")?
LowercaseReservedBitsPrimitive ::= "uint" IntLiteral ("be" | "le")? "reserves" IntLiteral
ReservedBitsPrimitive ::= "ReservedBits" "(" IntLiteral "," IntLiteral ")"
RepeatPrimitive ::= "Repeat" "(" CountExpr "," TypeText ")"
CanonicalRepeatPrimitive ::= "[" SchemaFieldType ";" CountExpr "]"
CountExpr ::= Name | Name ("-" | "+" | "*" | "/") Name
SchemaFieldWhere ::= "where" (ContractPredicate | ByteViewMultiplePredicate)
ByteViewMultiplePredicate ::= "payload_count" "multiple" "of" (Name | IntLiteral)
SchemaValidation ::= "validate" ContractPredicate NL
PublicAlias   ::= "pub" ("fn" | "type" | "schema") Name "=" MemberPath NL
TypeParamList ::= "<" Name ("," Name)* ","? ">"
EffectBinder  ::= "<" "effect" Name ">"
TypeVariant   ::= "pub"? UpperName TypeVariantFields? NL
TypeVariantFields ::= "(" TypeVariantField ("," TypeVariantField)* ","? ")"
                  | "{" TypeVariantField ("," TypeVariantField)* ","? "}"
TypeVariantField ::= Name ":" TypeText | TypeText
ParamList     ::= Param ("," Param)* ","?
Param         ::= Name (":" VariadicMarker? TypeText)?
VariadicMarker ::= "..."
Return        ::= "->" ResultBinding? TypeText
ResultBinding ::= Name ":"
Effects       ::= "effects" "[" EffectList? "]"
EffectList    ::= EffectEntry ("," EffectEntry)* ","?
EffectEntry   ::= MemberPath | "..." Name
Contract      ::= ("require" | "ensure" | "invariant") ContractPredicate NL
Body          ::= (LetLine | ExprLine)*
LetLine       ::= "let" LetPattern (":" TypeText)? "=" Expr NL
LetPattern    ::= "_" | BindingName | RecordPattern
ExprLine      ::= Expr NL
Expr          ::= PrefixExpr (BinaryOp PrefixExpr)*
BinaryOp      ::= "|>" | "or" | "and" | "|" | "^" | "&" | "==" | "!="
                  | "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=" | "<<" | ">>" | ">>>"
                  | "+" | "-" | "*" | "/"
PrefixExpr    ::= ("not" | "-" | "~") PrefixExpr | PostfixExpr
PostfixExpr   ::= PrimaryExpr (Call | TypeArgs | FieldAccess | "?")*
PrimaryExpr   ::= Hole | Literal | NamePath | Perform | Handle | SchemaDecode | SchemaEncode | "(" Expr ")" | "()"
                  | Record | Dict | List | Match | If
SchemaDecode  ::= "decode" MemberPath "from" Expr "at" Expr
SchemaEncode  ::= "encode" MemberPath "from" Expr
Perform       ::= "perform" MemberPath "::" Name "(" ArgList? ")"
Handle        ::= "handle" Expr "with" MemberPath "(" ArgList? ")"
Call          ::= "(" ArgList? ")"
ArgList       ::= Expr ("," Expr)* ","?
TypeArgs      ::= "<" TypeText ("," TypeText)* ","? ">"
FieldAccess   ::= "." Name
Record        ::= "{" (Name ":" Expr) ("," Name ":" Expr)* ","? "}"
Dict          ::= "{" Expr ":" Expr ("," Expr ":" Expr)* ","? "}"
List          ::= "[" ArgList? "]"
Match         ::= "match" Expr NL MatchArm+ "end"
MatchArm      ::= Pattern "=>" Expr NL
If            ::= "if" Expr NL Expr NL ElseIf* "else" NL Expr NL "end"
ElseIf        ::= "else" "if" Expr NL Expr NL
Pattern       ::= "_" | BindingName | Literal | ConstructorPattern | RecordPattern
ConstructorPattern ::= ConstructorName "(" PatternList? ")" | ConstructorName
ConstructorName ::= UpperName | Name "::" Name ("::" Name)*
RecordPattern ::= "{" PatternFieldList? "}"
PatternList   ::= Pattern ("," Pattern)* ","?
PatternFieldList ::= PatternField ("," PatternField)* ","?
PatternField  ::= Name ":" Pattern
MemberPath    ::= Name ("::" Name)*

topics.body: Expressions compose values. Patterns bind or select values at supported pattern positions.

examples.name: if expressions
examples.source:
fn choose(flag: Bool, fallback: Bool) -> Int
	if flag
		1
	else if fallback
		2
	else
		3
	end
end

fn if_inside_match(flag: Bool, payload: Result<Int, String>) -> Int
	match payload
		Result::Ok(value) => if flag
			value
		else
			0
		end
		Result::Err(_) => 0
	end
end

fn match_inside_if(flag: Bool, payload: Result<Int, String>) -> Int
	if flag
		match payload
			Result::Ok(value) => value
			Result::Err(_) => 0
		end
	else
		0
	end
end

fn add(left: Int, right: Int) -> Int
	left + right
end

fn as_argument(flag: Bool) -> Int
	add(if flag
		1
	else
		2
	end, 3)
end

fn as_record(flag: Bool) -> { value : Int }
	{ value: if flag
		1
	else
		2
	end }
end

fn as_result(flag: Bool) -> Result<Int, String>
	Result::Ok(if flag
		1
	else
		2
	end)
end

pub fn main(flag: Bool, fallback: Bool) -> Result<{ chosen : Int, record : { value : Int }, payload : Int }, String>
	let chosen = choose(flag, fallback)
	let record = as_record(flag)
	let payload = as_result(fallback)
	match payload
		Result::Ok(value) => Result::Ok({ chosen: chosen + as_argument(flag) + if_inside_match(flag, payload) + match_inside_if(fallback, payload), record: record, payload: value })
		Result::Err(error) => Result::Err(error)
	end
end

PrefixExpr    ::= ("not" | "-" | "~") PrefixExpr | PostfixExpr
PrimaryExpr   ::= Hole | Literal | NamePath | Perform | Handle | SchemaDecode | SchemaEncode | "(" Expr ")" | "()"
                  | Record | Dict | List | Match | If
If            ::= "if" Expr NL Expr NL ElseIf* "else" NL Expr NL "end"

topics.body: Effect rows describe required effects. Handlers provide explicit clauses for handled operations.

examples.name: handler operation signatures
examples.source:
effect Ask
	value() -> Int
	other() -> Int
	missing() -> Int
end

effect Single
	op() -> Int
end

fn wrong(ctx: Int, value: String) -> Int
	ctx
end

fn right(ctx: Int) -> Int
	ctx
end

fn recursive(ctx: Int) -> Int effects [Ask]
	perform Ask::value()
end

handler bad(ctx: Int) handles Ask
	value() => wrong(ctx, 1)
	other() => recursive(ctx)
end

handler duplicate_and_unknown(ctx: Int) handles Single
	op() => right(ctx)
	op() => right(ctx)
	extra() => right(ctx)
end

HandlerOperationClause ::= Name "(" HandlerOperationParams? ")" "=>" Expr NL
Effects       ::= "effects" "[" EffectList? "]"

topics.body: Contracts state checked predicates at declaration boundaries.

examples.name: contract result binding
examples.source:
# Contract result bindings give postconditions an explicit name for the return value.
fn has_items(items: Vec<Int>) -> Bool
	not vec_is_empty(items)
end

pub fn first_count(items: Vec<Int>) -> result: Int
	require has_items(items)
	require vec_len(items) > 0
	ensure result >= 0
	invariant vec_len(items) > 0
	vec_len(items)
end

topics.body: A hole marks an incomplete expression and preserves its optional label in diagnostics.

examples.name: named holes
examples.source:
# Named holes are repair labels, not value declarations, so reused labels do not collide.
fn main() -> Int
	let fallback: Int = 1
	let left: Int = _candidate
	let right: Int = _candidate
	fallback + left + right
end
